scope_completed: Aggregate-only duplicate, sibling, identity, and Variant Group readiness audit. No source text, title, identity, medical content, student data, or item-level legacy row was inspected.

findings.finding: No real candidate bank exists, so candidate duplicate rate, semantic sibling precision, and Variant Group assignment coverage are not measurable.
The platform stores Variant Groups but release assembly does not reject multiple items from the same Variant Group.
Legacy aggregate evidence identifies 11 duplicate-prompt groups and 328 base-vignette sibling pairs, but aggregate-only evidence provides no safe item-level membership for ranking or adjudication.
Unique source IDs and hashes prove artifact-level uniqueness only. They do not prove semantic uniqueness of teaching concepts or questions.
The static v4 and current STAT mirror have disjoint IDs and must remain separately versioned. Zero ID intersection is not evidence of zero content overlap.

proposed: Reject duplicate composite identities and exact content hashes before review.
Generate restricted normalized fingerprints and semantic candidate pairs, then adjudicate them on an untouched duplicate gold set.
Require every review candidate to have a Variant Group and invariant teaching point.
Reject sibling collisions during release assembly and record an explicit override only through governed review.
Add per-channel exposure and Variant Group cooldown controls after authorized attempts exist.

tests_performed: Read-only comparison of aggregate corpus, legacy, STAT, source, migration, and test evidence.
No pairwise content comparison, semantic embedding, medical review, or student-data query was performed.
Post-write validation passed for the exact six-file set, required keys, JSON parsing, zero forbidden Unicode dash characters, and zero trailing-whitespace lines.
risks: Artifact hash uniqueness may be misreported as semantic uniqueness.
Sibling items may appear together and create cueing or construct redundancy.
Disjoint identifiers may conceal cross-dataset content overlap.
Exposure controls cannot operate without privacy-safe attempt events and Variant Group membership.
blockers: No item-level legacy aggregate membership export
handoff: Root Supervisor should preserve the aggregate-only boundary, add release sibling exclusion, and require a restricted adjudicated duplicate report before claiming candidate-bank dedup readiness.
